title.en: Creating an Ad Hoc Committee to Evaluate and Study the Country's Various Sports Programs
title.orig: Creating an Ad Hoc Committee to Evaluate and Study the Country's Various Sports Programs

text.en:
There is hereby created an Ad Hoc Committee with the assigned functions to study and evaluate all
existing sports development programs in the country and upon completion of said study, to render a detailed
report and recommendation to the President.

The Committee shall be composed of the following:
Gov. Jose C. Sering,
Officer-in-Charge, Project: Gintong Alay and
President Philippine Amateur Track and Field Association.
Vice-Chairman:
Lt. Gen. Fidel V. Ramos,
Acting President, Philippine Olympic Committee and
President, Philippine Badminton Association.
Mr. Johnny Gatbonton,
Consultant to the Minister of Information, Office of Media Affairs.
Dr. Aparicio H. Mequi, Director,
Bureau of Sports Development (MECS)
Mr. Antonio Siddayao,
President Sports Writers Association of the Philippines
Mr. Edilberto Bonus,
President, Philippine Amateur Swimming Association
Mr. Benjamin Siva-nette,
former Olympic and representing Filipino athletes and coaches.

The Committee may appoint and/or designate such necessary officials and personnel to assist in the
efficient performances of its functions.

The Committee may adopt and promulgate rules and regulations as it considers necessary for the
effective discharge of its responsibilities.

To ensure effective performances of its functions, the Committee shall prepare an initial budget for the
Committee for the approval of the President to be drawn from the approved budget of Project Gintong Alay.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
eighty-five.
